title: MoleculesAI Cloud/Compute Provider SSOT
description: SSOT JSON-Schema (draft 2020-12) for contracts/cloudproviders.yaml — the single source of truth for the set of CLOUD/COMPUTE backends a tenant/workspace runs on (Molecules-Server/local, AWS, GCP, Hetzner). Distinct from the LLM provider registry. The Node generators under tools/ emit gen/{go,ts,python} from the validated instance. INVARIANT surfaced by tests/test_cloudproviders_contract.py: {every provider.persist} ∪ {""} equals the migration-056 organizations.provider CHECK set ('', 'aws', 'hetzner', 'gcp', 'local'), and backend_key == persist for every current row.

version.description: Schema/data revision of this contract instance.

default_id.description: The implicit provider id when a request omits one (an empty/blank provider Normalizes to this). Must reference a real provider id.

empty_normalizes_to.description: The id an empty/blank request value resolves to. Equals default_id; called out so the resolution rule is data, not code.

providers.description: The canonical, ORDERED provider list (display/selection order: clouds first, then the local self-hosted box). Order is byte-significant — it drives the Go All slice, CloudIDs() order, and the app dropdown order.

id.description: Canonical wire/UI id persisted on an org/workspace row and sent in the create/migrate API.

backend_key.description: Provisioner registry key the id routes to. Clouds == id; the local box routes to the historical 'local' (LocalDocker) key.

persist.description: Value the organizations.provider column stores. Constrained by migration 056: clouds persist their id, the local box persists 'local'.

is_local.description: True only for the self-hosted Molecules-Server box.

aliases.description: Alternate accepted wire spellings that Normalize to id (e.g. 'local'/'docker' → 'molecules-server').
